title: Mango Malletdrift
description: A sun-drenched FM marimba lead built from triangle waves plucked with a bright pitch-envelope click, drifting in and out of the stereo field on slow mutually-prime LFOs. Over 24 cycles the FM index blooms and collapses, the ladder filter squeezes and opens, and a stepped harmonic arc rotates the fmh — so the tone morphs from glassy bell to warm wood mallet and back.
code:
setcpm(100/4)
stack(
  note("<c4 c4 eb4 g4>*2").s("triangle")
    .fm(sine.slow(17).range(1.5, 8))
    .fmh("<1 1.5 2 1 3 1.5 2 0.75>/8")
    .penv("<0 0 12 -5>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.08)
    .lpf(sine.slow(24).range(900, 5200)).resonance(sine.slow(11).range(4, 14)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(4).lpattack(0.002).lpdecay(0.18)
    .attack(0.001).decay(0.22).sustain(0.3).release(0.1)
    .crush(saw.slow(31).range(14, 6))
    .shape(sine.slow(13).range(0.05, 0.35))
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.18, 0.82))
    .vib("<0 3 5>/16").vibmod(sine.slow(16).range(0.1, 0.9))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12.05)).gain(0.28).pan(0.78))
    .room(0.28).delay("0.3:0.375:0.5").gain(0.88)
)
